messages:
Maya S.: Quick heads up — ran two onboarding sessions with Nimbus and HelixCardio today. Both surfaced similar asks. Posting raw notes here so product can triage.

Jules R.: thanks — can you bullet the top pain points so we can slot into our next intake? :eyes:

Maya S.: sure. short list: 1) per-route billing confusion (customers unsure which route drives costs) 2) inability to see webhook retry history + dead-lettering 3) model mismatch on short prompts (users expecting concise answers but get verbose) 4) onboarding checklist unclear about keys/roles.

Omar K.: helpful — can you paste exemplar quotes or a snippet from the session? need to illustrate severity for PM review.

Maya S.: pasted snippets below (redacted):
- "We thought the analytics page showed per-route cost, turns out it's aggregated by model — we overspent."
- "When webhooks fail we get generic 500s; we have no way to see retries — recreating the request is painful."
- "We tried the short-prompt preset but the output kept rambling, wasted tokens."
- "New CSMs missed the step to create route keys; onboarding doc assumes engineer."

survey-bot: Summary report available — 6 responses from recent onboarding cohort. Top tags: billing_clarity (4), webhook_debug (3), short_prompt_quality (3), onboarding_roles (2). Report link: https://internal.redwood/reports/onboard-insights/1719999999

Jules R.: @Priya N. — flags for prioritization: per-route billing clarity seems high-impact for renewals. Webhook retry visibility is operational pain and causes support overhead.

Priya N.: thanks — can you estimate effort/impact quick scores? propose 1-5 scale. I can take a first pass and share with Eng.

Jules R.: my quick take: billing clarity = impact 5 / effort 3 (UI + analytics changes), webhook retry history = impact 4 / effort 4 (storage + UI), short-prompt preset tuning = impact 3 / effort 2, onboarding checklist UX = impact 2 / effort 1.

Maya S.: Nimbus explicitly tied renewal to billing visibility: "If we can see cost per route we can optimize monthly spend." flagged as renewal risk.

Omar K.: I'll own a mini-PRD for billing clarity. Plan: (a) add per-route cost breakdown to analytics, (b) add a tooltip + docs, (c) update onboarding checklist to highlight route keys. Will draft by EOD.

Priya N.: will slot webhook retry story into next sprint's reliability list; need eng estimate though. Also want a short A/B test for short-prompt preset adjustments.

Jules R.: thanks team. Action items:
- Maya: add any missing session quotes to the report link (by tomorrow).
- Omar: PRD for per-route billing (EOD).
- Priya: follow up on retry storage estimate with eng (sync w/eng-sre).
- Jules: create intake ticket and tag as renewal-risk-high.

Maya S.: done — added two more quotes and timestamped recordings to the report. :thumbsup:

survey-bot: Ticket created automatically: CS-4301 "Per-route billing clarity — renewal risk" assigned to Omar K. Link: https://internal.redwood/tickets/CS-4301

Omar K.: got the ticket, starting PRD now. will ping eng-runtime for feasibility on cost aggregation latency.

Priya N.: appreciate the quick turnaround. small ask: can CS include estimated customer ARR tied to each risk? helps prioritization.

Maya S.: yes — Nimbus ~$42k ARR, HelixCardio ~$18k. put in ticket comment.

Jules R.: perfect. I'll tag product review tomorrow and mark as priority for renewal cohort.

Maya S.: closing loop — will drop a one-pager for Sales to use in renewal calls once we have the analytics mock.

Omar K.: thanks everyone.
